hook: I want payday to never feel like a surprise

builtFor.context: KOHO set out to make financial services better for every Canadian: no hidden fees, no predatory interest. Cover is a big part of that promise, a zero-interest cash advance instead of an overdraft. The rule behind it is simple and fair, money in repays Cover first, but members only see the result, not the reason.

opportunities.title: Clear Payday
opportunities.body: Preview how the next deposit splits between Cover and Spendable, and show where every deposit went.

opportunities.title: Cover you can follow
opportunities.body: Bring Cover use and repayment back into view, so a $0.00 Spendable never reads as an error.

opportunities.title: AI that explains money
opportunities.body: Use AI to turn balances and rules into one plain sentence about what just happened and what's next.

body: Most of my work has been consumer financial products: a lending platform for female entrepreneurs at Shecluded, a wallet-first mobile checkout at Foodlify, and transaction-monitoring tools at Youverify.
I like the moments where money and trust meet, and I make ideas tangible early: the prototype in this pitch was built with AI tools, the way KOHO says it wants to work.

bring.title: Consumer fintech on mobile
bring.body: A loan dashboard redesign that lifted first-time engagement by 30%.

bring.title: Measurable value
bring.body: A checkout redesign that helped lift repeat orders by 31%.

bring.title: AI-assisted prototyping
bring.body: Working mobile prototypes in code, like the one in this pitch.

systemsGets: Someone who can design one sensitive money moment, like a deposit repaying Cover, and keep it consistent across Spend, Borrow and the rest of KOHO's product.

opportunity.title: Clear Payday
opportunity.problem: Money that comes in repays Cover first, out of sight. Cover isn't in the transaction feed, alerts show only Spendable, and a small deposit can go entirely to Cover. A July 2026 complaint read exactly this as a system error.
opportunity.solution: Show the split before and after money lands. Home previews the next deposit (about $1,240: $150 to Cover, about $1,090 to spend), and every deposit shows where it went and why, with your full Cover limit ready again.

firstWeek.intro: My first week would focus on how members experience Cover and payday, then contributing one useful improvement with the team.

days.body: Meet product, design, engineering, data and support. Learn the roadmap, the design system and how success is measured.
Review support data, complaints and research about Cover, deposits and cash-outs.
Agree on one moment to improve, grounded in evidence and KOHO's policies.
Prototype it with AI tools, and review edge cases with an engineer and a data analyst.
Share findings, the prototype, the trade-offs and a plan to test it with members.

ask: I'd love to bring consumer-fintech design experience and fast, AI-assisted prototyping to KOHO's mission of financially empowering a generation of Canadians.
